name: oracle-devops
description: DevOps sub-plugin of the oracle harness. Bundles Anton Babenko's terraform-skill@v1.8.0 (Terraform / OpenTofu modules, tests, CI, scans, state ops, with version-aware guards diagnosing identity churn, secrets, blast radius, CI drift, and state corruption) plus four cherry-picked Firecrawl workflow skills useful for DevOps work (knowledge-base build, knowledge-ingest, web-content QA, website-design-clone for extracting design systems from running sites). Install per project root or per DevOps repo to get the terraform skill + the four research-into-implementation workflows in one shot.
